description: Raw customer profile records from all ticketing platforms. Contains PII fields (first_name, last_name, email, phone) — ingested as-is per MVP scope. PII masking is planned for post-MVP. Deduplication and standardisation happens in silver_customers. Consumed by: silver_customers → gold_customer_behaviour.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the customer, assigned by the source platform. Natural key — deduplicated in silver_customers keeping the latest record.

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: PII: Customer first name. Ingested as-is per MVP scope. To be masked in post-MVP phase.

fields.name: last_name
fields.description: PII: Customer last name. Ingested as-is per MVP scope. To be masked in post-MVP phase.

fields.name: email
fields.description: PII: Customer email address. Ingested as-is per MVP scope. To be masked in post-MVP phase.

fields.name: phone
fields.description: PII: Customer phone number. Ingested as-is per MVP scope. To be masked in post-MVP phase.

fields.name: country_of_residence
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the customer's country of residence. Standardised to UPPER in silver_customers. Used as a regional dimension in gold_customer_behaviour.

fields.name: signup_date
fields.description: Date the customer first registered on the platform. Cast to DATE in silver_customers. Used to derive customer_tenure_days in gold_customer_behaviour.

fields.name: loyalty_tier
fields.description: Loyalty programme tier. Accepted values: BRONZE, SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM. Standardised to UPPER in silver_customers. Used as a segmentation dimension in gold_customer_behaviour.

fields.name: platform_source
fields.description: Platform where the customer originally registered. Standardised to UPPER in silver_customers.

fields.name: ingested_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when this record was written to BigQuery by the ingestion pipeline. Used as the incremental predicate in silver_customers (3-day lookback window).
